Since I have the authority to approve the production rollout policy, I'd like us to work through the final build, security, and operations checklist so we can make a decision on enabling this automation across all repositories. Who wants to start walking through the checklist items?

transcript.text: While investigating an unrelated CI queue delay this morning, I confirmed that each dependency-upgrade pull request consumes two shared runner slots and that the organization has 20 slots total. To preserve four slots for ordinary developer builds, the bot must have no more than eight open pull requests at once. I haven't updated the rollout proposal yet, but this is an important operations constraint for the checklist.

transcript.text: I have a security checklist item to add. I haven't added this to the bot configuration ticket yet, but it needs to be enforced before production rollout.
